outline.title: One direct technical owner

outline.title: Choose the smallest package that moves the business forward
outline.summary: Frame the three service packages as a simple decision model: feature addition, standard ecommerce, or Growth Ultra.

outline.title: Add a capability without rebuilding everything
outline.summary: Present the AI, AR, or other scoped feature-addition package with founding and standard pricing, scope, and exclusions.

outline.title: Build a sharper storefront in three to four weeks
outline.summary: Present the Standard Custom Ecommerce package with founding and standard pricing and its defined scope.

outline.title: One complete package for a stronger launch
outline.summary: Present the Complete Growth Ultra Ecommerce package, pricing, deliverables, and a clear definition of all included.

outline.title: Keep the store healthy after launch
outline.summary: Present the 10-hour and 20-hour monthly retainers, including maintenance and hot-fix support.

outline.title: The thinking and documentation come with the work
outline.summary: Explain the free-included strategy, audits, roadmaps, technical notes, and handoff documentation, plus transparent exclusions.

outline.title: Clear process. Short feedback loops.
outline.summary: Show the four-step engagement process: align, build, refine, and handoff.

outline.title: Start with the problem, not the biggest package
outline.summary: Closing slide with Commerce Studio, the invitation to share the problem, and founding-rate availability for the first five paid clients.
